        suffix = t[-i:]

def check_and_reconstruct_message(t):
    n = len(t)
    for i in range(1, n // 2 + 1):
        if n % i != 0:
            continue
        prefix = t[:i]
        if all(t[j:j+i] == prefix for j in range(i, n, i)):
            return "YES", prefix
    return "NO", ""

def check_error(t):
    n = len(t)
    
    # Check if there's any overlapping substring that could have caused the error
    for i in range(1, n // 2 + 1):
        if t[:i] == t[n - i:]:
            return True, t[:i]
    
    return False, None
